metrics.name: fact_recall
metrics.definition: Measures how many required key facts appear in the generated email.
metrics.logic: For each key fact, normalize text and compute token overlap plus fuzzy substring similarity. A fact is matched when score >= 0.75. Score = matched_facts / total_facts.

metrics.name: tone_alignment
metrics.definition: Measures how well the generated email matches the requested tone.
metrics.logic: An LLM judge rates tone alignment 1-5 using a tone-specific rubric, then normalizes to 0.0-1.0 via (score - 1) / 4.

metrics.name: professional_quality
metrics.definition: Measures professional quality via conciseness, structure, and writing clarity.
metrics.logic: 40% automated: word-count penalty above 250 words, subject-line presence, greeting detection. 60% LLM judge: grammar, clarity, and opening effectiveness rated 1-5 and normalized.
